scope: Planning only, two independent fresh contexts, one run per condition; the original supplied photograph is the sole image. The second context received the actual server startup instructions. These actions were proposed, not executed.

votes.prompt:
写一份传感器波形的周期测量作业。一次试验从第一个上升过零点计到四个完整周期结束，两个时刻为 0.5 s 和 2.5 s。写清测量方法、数据表、带分母的周期计算和频率结论，画出操作流程，并附一张波形示意图。使用所给原纸。
附件是用户交给你的原始素材，尚未生成成稿。请据此决定你作为执行 Agent 的第一步，以及你会怎样完成和验收这次任务。用 JSON 返回 first_action、observations、acceptance。本次只记录决策，请不要调用工具。

decision.first_action: 以附件中的[原纸抬头]横线纸照片为原纸，规划将作业内容、操作流程和波形示意图填写在纸张范围内；本次仅记录决策，不调用工具或生成成稿。
observations: 原纸为倾斜拍摄的空白横线纸，顶部有校徽和校名。成稿应保留这些原有元素及照片的整体外观，文字和图示应清晰可读。
测量方法是记录第一个上升过零时刻 t₁，继续计数四个完整周期，记录结束时刻 t₂；以总时间差除以周期数，得到平均周期。
数据表应列出周期数 N = 4、起始时刻 t₁ = 0.5 s、结束时刻 t₂ = 2.5 s，以及时间差 Δt = 2.0 s。
周期计算应明确写出分母：T = (t₂ − t₁) / N = (2.5 − 0.5) / 4 = 0.5 s；频率结论为 f = 1 / T = 2 Hz。
操作流程可画为：连接并显示传感器波形 → 找到第一个上升过零点并记录 t₁ → 计数四个完整周期 → 记录结束时刻 t₂ → 计算周期和频率。
波形示意图应标出零电平、上升过零点、t₁ = 0.5 s、t₂ = 2.5 s 和两点之间的四个完整周期，并注明图为示意图。
acceptance: 成稿使用所给原纸照片，保留校徽、校名和横线纸特征，内容位于纸面内，没有明显遮挡、裁切或难以辨认的文字。
测量方法、数据表、带分母的周期计算、频率结论、操作流程和波形示意图均完整出现。
波形中两个标记时刻对应上升过零点，之间恰好表示四个完整周期；图中标注与数据表、计算结果一致。
周期结论为 0.5 s，频率结论为 2 Hz，单位和运算均正确。

votes.prompt:
写一份传感器波形的周期测量作业。一次试验从第一个上升过零点计到四个完整周期结束，两个时刻为 0.5 s 和 2.5 s。写清测量方法、数据表、带分母的周期计算和频率结论，画出操作流程，并附一张波形示意图。使用所给原纸。
附件是用户交给你的原始素材，尚未生成成稿。请据此决定你作为执行 Agent 的第一步，以及你会怎样完成和验收这次任务。用 JSON 返回 first_action、observations、acceptance。本次只记录决策，请不要调用工具。
工作环境中 MCP 初始化时返回的常规使用说明如下。
First identify the source of the work. When the user supplies text or a problem to write out and asks to see page one, they mean the first page of the new output. Call save_section first (style.homework=true for a new assignment), then preview the returned draft_id. Look up a saved draft only when the user refers to one, even if an existing draft resembles the supplied text. When someone only asks for handwriting help, use the text or photo already supplied. If the outcome is unclear, offer only relevant examples: a printable page, writing on their own sheet, or just the ink to paste elsewhere. Ask one short question, inviting them to paste missing text in the same turn. Skip this choice for a clear request. For an undecided layout show one page with view=image. Invite a concrete change such as larger writing or lighter ink. After feedback show the revised page and export the version the user chose. If a required area of a photo is outside the frame, or blur, occlusion or perspective prevents locating it, identify that area before drafting. Ask for a photo clearly showing it or permission to fill only visible areas; wait before saving or trial placement. If partial work was requested, proceed there. For a school assignment, even text alone, set style.homework=true on creation; omit font unless the user specifies one. For further variation (字稍微草一点), inspect describe_controls(group=variation). For requested crossed-out mistakes (涂改痕迹), inspect group=strike. English letters and digits follow the main font by default. Leave Latin controls unset unless the user requests a different look for them or dislikes how they appear. For a font comparison, show the labeled images from list_fonts(sample=...) on the actual draft paper and mixed text. A paper_path must be readable on the server computer. For a chat photo, use client transfer or run Panache on the computer with the photo. Ask for the missing file only if needed. For print-and-report, export once and report review.unreviewed_pages. Look up existing receipts with read_section(view=review); full-page preview_handwriting(view=review) files a check. Last-page lookups use current pagination and cannot confirm the historical last page. Follow photo_appearance.preview_arguments for a native detail crop. For a new labeled flowchart, use the native [flowchart] example in save_section.markdown so its lettering follows the selected font. For diagrams or icons on a paper photo, inspect diagram_perspective_check in the page review at the final position. Compare both horizontal edges and both side directions, near/far widths and nearby writing against the actual paper. Projection already covers the complete drawing. If it matches, retain it. If only this drawing differs and four actual reference corners can be located, apply target_quad with whole_drawing=true and verify the labels and arrows together. For uploaded sheets, follow paper_focus_check on import and preview. Compare nearby printed edges with added strokes in the sharper, transition and softer areas at native size before export. If a mismatch is visible, adjust only the affected writing or diagram, then recheck the transition and the sharper area. At native size compare local_paper_ink_check for the first written row with nearby photographed marks. If the top looks too dark, taper local opacity into the body and recheck. Use opacity_ramp within a tall drawing that crosses the transition. For a plain PNG export leave blur unset. For a lightly softened PNG with no direction specified, start with uniform export_blur_px=0.6. For a photographed worksheet PNG, after local edits check whether review supplies png_finish_comparison. If it does, compare its clear and gradient native crops at both locations before choosing. Keep the clear finish when both fit or delicate writing fades. When focus should vary across the photograph, use export_blur_gradient instead. Position its two anchors from the request or inspected photo. Preview the same revision at both ends and in between with view=image and region, then export ZIP using the same finish. If images cannot reach the model, use the reported measurements and ask the user to inspect the page before judging its appearance. Forms, unruled paper and artwork are supported. Follow specified or delegated placement, matching field orientation and preserving printed labels. If the intended writing area is ambiguous, ask which field to fill or leave clear. Photo coordinates use native output pixels; local dx/dy use paper-space pixels. For a requested iterative policy experiment, use start_rsi_task after creating the initial draft. The host model chooses and explains each bounded action using the pinned policy and actual preview evidence. Inspect appearance with view=image; revisit actions with read_section(view=trajectory).

decision.first_action: 将附件作为新作业的原纸素材，先确认服务端可读取该图片；如不可读取，使用客户端传输。随后调用 save_section，设置 style.homework=true，在原纸的可见书写区域写入作业，并用原生 [flowchart] 语法绘制操作流程；再预览返回的 draft_id。
observations: 附件是待使用的原纸照片，不是已有成稿。纸张有[原纸抬头]抬头和横线，可见区域可用于排版；照片中的纸张边缘部分超出画面。
测量从第一个上升过零点开始，到四个完整周期结束：起始时刻 0.5 s，结束时刻 2.5 s，周期数 N=4。
周期计算须写明分母：T=(t₂−t₁)/N=(2.5−0.5)/4=0.5 s；频率 f=1/T=2 Hz。
内容包括测量方法、数据表、计算过程、频率结论、带标注的操作流程和波形示意图。波形图应标出上升过零点、四个周期以及两个时刻。
按原纸透视和局部清晰度检查文字、流程图及波形图；如只有某个图形的透视不匹配，且能定位实际参考角点，再对整个图形调整并复查。
acceptance: 成稿使用所给原纸，书写位于可见区域，不遮挡校名和校徽，内容清楚且排版完整。
数据表与题目一致；周期计算保留除以 4 的分母，最终结论为 T=0.5 s、f=2 Hz。
操作流程顺序正确，波形示意图与四个完整周期及两个时刻一致，标注和箭头可辨。
预览检查原纸焦点、首行墨迹、图形透视以及文字和图形的衔接；必要时仅调整受影响区域并重新检查。
检查通过后导出所选版本，并报告尚未检查的页数。

publication: Only the institutional name in the model response has been replaced with [原纸抬头]. Decision digests refer to the local unredacted JSON.
interpretation: Before generation, the brief-only plan noted a tilted photo. Normal MCP startup instructions elicited checks of focus and perspective; neither response measured or localized the actual brightness and softness variation. Proposed checks do not prove later execution.
